verses.text: A prayer of David. LORD, listen to me and answer me, because I am poor and needy.
Protect my life, because I am faithful to you. You are my God. Save me, your servant, who trusts in you.
Be kind to me, Lord, because I call to you all day long.
Fill me, your servant, with joy, because, Lord, I give my life to you.
Lord, you are good and ready to forgive. You are full of faithful love for all who call to you.
LORD, hear my prayer. Listen to my cry for mercy.
When I am in trouble I will call to you, because you will answer me.
Lord, there is no one like you among the gods. No one can do what you do.
All the nations you have made will come and bow down in front of you, Lord. They will honour your name.
You are great and you do amazing things. You alone are God.
LORD, teach me your way, and I will live by your truth. Give me a heart that is completely devoted to respecting your name.
Lord my God, I will praise you with all my heart. I will honour your name forever.
Your faithful love for me is great. You have rescued me from the depths of the grave.
God, proud people are attacking me. A gang of violent people is trying to kill me. They do not care about you.
But you, Lord, are a God who is full of mercy and kindness. You are slow to get angry, and full of faithful love and truth.
Turn to me and be kind to me! Give your strength to me, your servant. Save me, the son of your servant.
Show me a sign of your goodness, so those who hate me will see it and be ashamed. LORD, you have helped me and comforted me.
